notes: One Firstock subscription carries every mode; the web publishes each subscribed mode from the same snapshot and answers every subscribe with five levels (firstock_adapter.py:300-307).
The web streams no Firstock order updates: Firstock is in neither the order-update adapter factories nor the polling brokers, and the adapter's order handler only logs (firstock_adapter.py:917-920).
Firstock has no book-clear signal the web acts on: a side left with no valid level keeps the previous side (firstock_adapter.py:683-744).
